passwordPolicy: length(12) and upperCase(1) and lowerCase(1) and digits(1) and specialChars(1) and notUsername(undefined)

realm.name: cd-admin
realm.description: Full administrative access to all CoreDirective services

realm.name: cd-operator
realm.description: Day-to-day operational access, can manage workflows and containers

realm.name: cd-auditor
realm.description: Read-only access to audit logs, session recordings, and compliance data

realm.name: agent:soc-tier1
realm.description: Tier 1 squire: read-only Datadog alert triage. No write capability.

realm.name: agent:soc-defensive
realm.description: Tier 3 blue_squire: production write tools (isolate, block, revoke), approval-gated.

realm.name: agent:soc-offensive
realm.description: Tier 4 red_squire: adversarial probing in sandboxed ephemeral container with egress allow-list.

realm.name: agent:grc-corpus
realm.description: Tier 2 grc_librarian: public sanitized GRC corpus, PR comment write only.

realm.name: agent:audit
realm.description: Tier 2.5 keeper_squire: internal sensitive corpus read, local filesystem write only.

realm.name: agent:drift-detector
realm.description: Non-LLM drift observer: read-only access to facts and audit logs.

clients.name: Squire - Tier 1 SOC triage agent
clients.description: Read-only Datadog alert triage. Token role: agent:soc-tier1. Secret in Doppler KC_CLIENT_SECRET_SQUIRE.

clients.name: Blue Squire - Tier 3 incident responder
clients.description: Production write tools, approval-gated. Token role: agent:soc-defensive. Secret in Doppler KC_CLIENT_SECRET_BLUE_SQUIRE. Lifespan tightened to 60s (eBook step-up for high-risk).

clients.name: Red Squire - Tier 4 adversarial probe
clients.description: Sandboxed ephemeral container, egress allow-list. Token role: agent:soc-offensive. Secret in Doppler KC_CLIENT_SECRET_RED_SQUIRE.

clients.name: GRC Librarian - Tier 2 standards lookup
clients.description: Public corpus retrieval, PR comment write only. Token role: agent:grc-corpus. Secret in Doppler KC_CLIENT_SECRET_GRC_LIBRARIAN.

clients.name: Keeper Squire - Tier 2.5 internal threat modeling
clients.description: Internal sensitive corpus, local filesystem write only. Token role: agent:audit. Secret in Doppler KC_CLIENT_SECRET_KEEPER_SQUIRE.

clients.name: Drift Detector - non-LLM observer
clients.description: Read-only facts and audit logs. Token role: agent:drift-detector. Secret in Doppler KC_CLIENT_SECRET_DRIFT_DETECTOR.
